prompt: Trace a Codex prompt from the installed hook through prompt-submit to the context returned to the host. Name the modules and the key handoff functions/fields in order.

must.why: maps the host event to the prompt-submit verb

never.why: the active Codex registration is task-event; the older prompt-submit verb is retained only as a legacy marker/fixture
the hook brief does not start daemons or build indexes

criteria: Codex UserPromptSubmit maps to the prompt-submit task-event verb and the installed command includes task-event plus --provider codex.
The ordered flow is supported by source handoffs; it does not prove a live host forwarded or used the context.
task_hook::process starts the brief, start_brief calls execution_brief::chain::start, with_brief attaches completed text, and envelope returns it as additionalContext.
